module rtlpp_11126 (
    input wire clk_in,
    input wire data_in,
    input wire scan_select_in,
    input wire latch_enable_in,
    output wire clk_out,
    output wire data_out,
    output wire scan_select_out,
    output wire latch_enable_out
    );

    wire clk;
    wire data_out_i;
    parameter NUM_IOS = 8;
    
    wire [NUM_IOS-1:0] scan_data_out;   
    wire [NUM_IOS-1:0] scan_data_in;    
    wire [NUM_IOS-1:0] module_data_in;  
    wire [NUM_IOS-1:0] module_data_out;

    // Buffer logic for inputs and outputs

    assign clk = clk_in;
    assign clk_out = clk;
    assign data_out = data_out_i;
    assign scan_select_out = scan_select_in;
    assign latch_enable_out = latch_enable_in;

    assign scan_data_in = {scan_data_out[NUM_IOS-2:0], data_in};

    // Replacement for sky130_fd_sc_hd__dfrtn_1
    reg data_out_i_reg;
    always @(negedge clk or negedge 1'b1) begin
        if (!1'b1)
            data_out_i_reg <= 1'b0;
        else
            data_out_i_reg <= scan_data_out[NUM_IOS-1];
    end
    assign data_out_i = data_out_i_reg;

    // Replacement for sky130_fd_sc_hd__sdfxtp_1 and sky130_fd_sc_hd__dlxtp_1
    reg [NUM_IOS-1:0] scan_data_out_reg;
    reg [NUM_IOS-1:0] module_data_in_reg;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        scan_data_out_reg <= scan_select_in ? module_data_out : scan_data_in;
    end

    always @(posedge latch_enable_in) begin
        module_data_in_reg <= scan_data_out_reg;
    end

    assign scan_data_out = scan_data_out_reg;
    assign module_data_in = module_data_in_reg;

    generate
        genvar i;
        for (i = 0; i < NUM_IOS; i = i + 1) begin : user_logic
            // Example logic replacement for user_module
            assign module_data_out[i] = module_data_in[i]; // Placeholder logic
        end
    endgenerate

endmodule
